name: The One Who Runs Away Is Chased
storyline:
A cute yellow hero is constantly chased in a colorful world. Run, jump, and survive through endless procedurally generated levels in this fast-paced 2D platformer.

Time your jumps perfectly, collect coins, and aim for the highest score while avoiding obstacles and dangerous chasers.

Simple to learn, hard to master.
summary:
The One Who Runs Away Is Chased

Simple. Cute. Addictively fun!

Take control of your adorable little yellow hero as you run and jump through endless procedurally generated levels. Time your jumps perfectly, avoid falling, and aim for the highest score possible!

Easy to learn but challenging to master, Kaçan Kovalanır is a fast-paced 2D platformer that's perfect for quick play sessions or chasing your personal best.
